## apiome schemas {#schemas}

List and fetch tenant schemas.

```text
apiome schemas [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`get`](#schemas-get), [`list`](#schemas-list).

## apiome schemas get {#schemas-get}

Fetch one schema by id (GET /v1/classes/{tenant_slug}/{id}).

```text
apiome schemas get [OPTIONS] SCHEMA_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SCHEMA_ID` | uuid | yes | Schema UUID. |

## apiome schemas list {#schemas-list}

List tenant schemas (GET /v1/classes/{tenant_slug}).

```text
apiome schemas list [OPTIONS]
```
